diff --git a/apps/android-terminal/android-app/app/src/main/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/ChargingReceiptService.kt b/apps/android-terminal/android-app/app/src/main/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/ChargingReceiptService.kt
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..03cbafc9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/android-terminal/android-app/app/src/main/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/ChargingReceiptService.kt
@@ -0,0 +1,93 @@
+package com.complex.terminal
+
+// 文件版本：V0.01
+
+import android.app.Notification
+import android.app.NotificationChannel
+import android.app.NotificationManager
+import android.app.Service
+import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
+import android.content.Context
+import android.content.Intent
+import android.content.IntentFilter
+import android.os.Build
+import android.os.IBinder
+
+/**
+ * U01-002（BSM L1445 取离充电设施本身也算领取）：拔线接收器由前台服务常驻持有，应用被回收或开机后由 [BootReceiver] 重新拉起，
+ * 不依赖「请保持应用运行」文案。投递经 [ChargingReceiptBridge] 交给活动页记录；活动不在时记为待补记，下次登录后补记。
+ */
+class ChargingReceiptService : Service() {
+  private val receiver = object : BroadcastReceiver() {
+    override fun onReceive(context: Context?, intent: Intent?) {
+      if (intent?.action == Intent.ACTION_POWER_DISCONNECTED) ChargingReceiptBridge.deliver(this@ChargingReceiptService)
+    }
+  }
+
+  override fun onCreate() {
+    super.onCreate()
+    val manager = getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
+    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
+      manager.createNotificationChannel(NotificationChannel(CHANNEL, "工作手机考勤监听", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_MIN))
+    }
+    val notification: Notification = Notification.Builder(this, CHANNEL)
+      .setContentTitle("工作手机考勤监听运行中")
+      .setContentText("取离充电设施会自动记录上班领取")
+      .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_lock_idle_charging)
+      .build()
+    startForeground(NOTIFICATION_ID, notification)
+    val filter = IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_POWER_DISCONNECTED)
+    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) registerReceiver(receiver, filter, Context.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED) else registerReceiver(receiver, filter)
+  }
+
+  override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int = START_STICKY
+
+  override fun onDestroy() {
+    runCatching { unregisterReceiver(receiver) }
+    super.onDestroy()
+  }
+
+  override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null
+
+  companion object {
+    private const val CHANNEL = "charging_receipt"
+    private const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 4101
+    fun start(context: Context) {
+      val intent = Intent(context, ChargingReceiptService::class.java)
+      if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) context.startForegroundService(intent) else context.startService(intent)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+/** 拔线事件投递桥：活动在前台即时记录；否则落待补记标记（时刻以补记时为准，服务端仍取最早一次）。 */
+object ChargingReceiptBridge {
+  private const val PREFS = "charging_receipts"
+  private const val PENDING_KEY = "pending_charging_disconnect_at"
+
+  @Volatile
+  var handler: (() -> Unit)? = null
+
+  fun deliver(context: Context) {
+    val current = handler
+    if (current != null) {
+      current()
+    } else {
+      context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit().putLong(PENDING_KEY, System.currentTimeMillis()).apply()
+    }
+  }
+
+  /** 取走待补记标记；返回是否存在。 */
+  fun consumePending(context: Context): Boolean {
+    val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+    val pending = prefs.getLong(PENDING_KEY, 0L) > 0L
+    if (pending) prefs.edit().remove(PENDING_KEY).apply()
+    return pending
+  }
+}
+
+/** 开机后重新拉起常驻监听服务（U01-002）。 */
+class BootReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {
+  override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
+    if (intent.action == Intent.ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED) ChargingReceiptService.start(context)
+  }
+}

diff --git a/apps/android-terminal/src/main/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/DeviceRequestHeaders.kt b/apps/android-terminal/src/main/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/DeviceRequestHeaders.kt
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..a9d088e3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/android-terminal/src/main/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/DeviceRequestHeaders.kt
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+package com.complex.terminal
+
+// 文件版本：V0.01
+
+import java.security.MessageDigest
+import java.util.UUID
+
+/** 与后端 DeviceCredentialVerifier 使用同一份请求正文、路径与毫秒时间戳。 */
+fun deviceRequestHeaders(
+  deviceId: String,
+  method: String,
+  path: String,
+  body: String,
+  signer: (ByteArray) -> String,
+  timestamp: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
+  nonce: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
+): Map<String, String> {
+  require(deviceId.isNotBlank()) { "工作手机设备编号不能为空" }
+  val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
+    .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
+  val canonical = listOf(deviceId, timestamp.toString(), nonce, method.uppercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT),
+    path.substringBefore('?'), digest).joinToString("\n")
+  return mapOf(
+    "X-Device-Id" to deviceId,
+    "X-Device-Timestamp" to timestamp.toString(),
+    "X-Device-Nonce" to nonce,
+    "X-Device-Signature" to signer(canonical.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)),
+  )
+}

diff --git a/apps/android-terminal/src/test/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/DeviceRequestHeadersTest.kt b/apps/android-terminal/src/test/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/DeviceRequestHeadersTest.kt
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..5fa7b73f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/android-terminal/src/test/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/DeviceRequestHeadersTest.kt
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+package com.complex.terminal
+
+// 文件版本：V0.01
+
+import java.security.KeyPairGenerator
+import java.security.Signature
+import java.security.MessageDigest
+import java.util.Base64
+import kotlin.test.Test
+import kotlin.test.assertEquals
+import kotlin.test.assertTrue
+import kotlin.test.assertFalse
+
+class DeviceRequestHeadersTest {
+  @Test fun signedBytesMatchServerCanonicalAndDetectBodyChange() {
+    val keys = KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("EC").apply { initialize(256) }.generateKeyPair()
+    val body = "{\"method\":\"qr\",\"tag_ref\":\"点位一\"}"
+    val headers = deviceRequestHeaders("phone-1", "post", "/api/v1/staff/attendance/punch?view=x", body,
+      signer = { bytes -> Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(Signature.getInstance("SHA256withECDSA").run {
+        initSign(keys.private); update(bytes); sign()
+      }) }, timestamp = 123456L, nonce = "event-1")
+    fun verifies(content: String): Boolean {
+      val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(content.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
+        .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
+      val canonical = "phone-1\n123456\nevent-1\nPOST\n/api/v1/staff/attendance/punch\n$digest"
+      return Signature.getInstance("SHA256withECDSA").run {
+        initVerify(keys.public); update(canonical.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
+        verify(Base64.getDecoder().decode(headers.getValue("X-Device-Signature")))
+      }
+    }
+    assertEquals("phone-1", headers["X-Device-Id"])
+    assertEquals("123456", headers["X-Device-Timestamp"])
+    assertTrue(verifies(body))
+    assertFalse(verifies(body.replace("qr", "nfc")))
+  }
+}
diff --git a/apps/android-terminal/src/test/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/TerminalApiClientHeadersTest.kt b/apps/android-terminal/src/test/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/TerminalApiClientHeadersTest.kt
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..f38e0314
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/android-terminal/src/test/kotlin/com/complex/terminal/TerminalApiClientHeadersTest.kt
@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+package com.complex.terminal
+
+// 文件版本：V0.01
+
+import java.net.URI
+import java.net.http.HttpRequest
+import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
+import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
+import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
+import kotlin.test.Test
+import kotlin.test.assertEquals
+import kotlin.test.assertNotNull
+import kotlin.test.assertNull
+
+/** U02-003/U01-008：终端身份只来自绑定类型、设备签名头与验签器规范串一致、注册请求携带设备证明（可失败断言）。 */
+class TerminalApiClientHeadersTest {
+  private val api = TerminalApiClient("http://127.0.0.1:1")
+
+  private fun headers(path: String, method: String = "POST", body: String = "{}", override: String? = null): Map<String, List<String>> {
+    val builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder().uri(URI.create("http://127.0.0.1:1$path"))
+    if (method == "POST") builder.POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body)) else builder.GET()
+    api.applyHeaders(builder, path, method, body, override)
+    return builder.build().headers().map()
+  }
+
+  @Test
+  fun unboundClientDeclaresNoTerminalTypeAndNoDeviceHeaders() {
+    val h = headers("/api/v1/staff/shifts")
+    assertNull(h["X-Terminal-Type"])
+    assertNull(h["X-Device-Id"])
+  }
+
+  @Test
+  fun terminalTypeComesFromBindingNotFromPath() {
+    api.terminalType = "tablet"
+    assertEquals(listOf("tablet"), headers("/api/v1/services/orders")["X-Terminal-Type"])
+    // 不按路径改报：同一绑定下注册路径也只报绑定类型；私人手机通道由调用方显式声明。
+    assertEquals(listOf("tablet"), headers("/api/v1/staff/self-registrations")["X-Terminal-Type"])
+    assertEquals(listOf(STAFF_PRIVATE_PHONE), headers("/api/v1/staff/self-registrations", override = STAFF_PRIVATE_PHONE)["X-Terminal-Type"])
+  }
+
+  @Test
+  fun deviceSignatureHeadersFollowVerifierCanonicalFormExceptLogin() {
+    api.deviceId = "dev-1"
+    api.terminalType = "staff_work_phone"
+    var signed: ByteArray? = null
+    api.deviceSigner = { bytes -> signed = bytes; "sig" }
+    val body = "{\"a\":1}"
+    val h = headers("/api/v1/staff/attendance/punch", body = body)
+    assertEquals(listOf("dev-1"), h["X-Device-Id"])
+    assertEquals(listOf("sig"), h["X-Device-Signature"])
+    assertNotNull(h["X-Device-Timestamp"])
+    assertNotNull(h["X-Device-Nonce"])
+    val canonical = String(signed!!, Charsets.UTF_8).split("\n")
+    assertEquals("dev-1", canonical[0])
+    assertEquals("POST", canonical[3])
+    assertEquals("/api/v1/staff/attendance/punch", canonical[4])
+    assertNull(headers("/api/v1/auth/login")["X-Device-Id"])
+  }
+
+  @Test
+  fun selfRegistrationRequestCarriesDeviceProofInSnakeCase() {
+    val json = api.json.parseToJsonElement(
+      api.json.encodeToString(
+        StaffSelfRegistrationRequest(
+          idempotencyKey = "k1", companyId = "company_1", name = "员工",
+          devicePublicKey = "PUBKEY", deviceFingerprintHash = "abcd",
+        ),
+      ),
+    ).jsonObject
+    assertEquals("PUBKEY", json["device_public_key"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content)
+    assertEquals("abcd", json["device_fingerprint_hash"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content)
+    assertEquals("company_1", json["company_id"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content)
+  }
+
+  @Test
+  fun bindRequestCarriesStaffIdForWorkPhone() {
+    val json = api.json.parseToJsonElement(
+      api.json.encodeToString(BindDeviceRequest(deviceId = "dev-1", staffId = "staff_1", idempotencyKey = "b1")),
+    ).jsonObject
+    assertEquals("staff_1", json["staff_id"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content)
+    assertEquals("staff_work_phone", json["terminal_type"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content)
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+// 文件版本：V0.02
+import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
+import { afterEach, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+import { StaffShiftAttendancePage } from "./StaffShiftAttendancePage";
+import { StaffPayrollLeavePage } from "./StaffPayrollLeavePage";
+import { AdminApi } from "../client/adminClient";
+import type { AdminPageProps } from "../types";
+
+afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());
+
+function fixture() {
+  const posts: Array<{ url: string; body: Record<string, unknown> }> = [];
+  vi.stubGlobal("fetch", vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
+    const url = String(input);
+    let data: unknown = { items: [], page: 1, page_size: 50, total: 0 };
+    if (url.includes("/settings/shift-visible-days")) data = { value: 7, min_value: null, max_value: null };
+    if (url.includes("/settings/payroll-penalty-cap")) data = { value: 2000, min_value: 0, max_value: 10000 };
+    if (init?.method === "POST") {
+      posts.push({ url, body: JSON.parse(String(init.body)) });
+      data = { review_id: "review-cap", review_status: "pending_review" };
+    }
+    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, code: "OK", data }), { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
+  }));
+  const props: AdminPageProps = { api: new AdminApi("test"), user: { id: "u1", username: "admin", accountType: "platform_admin" },
+    setActionResult: vi.fn(), setGlobalError: vi.fn(), effectivePermissions: { status: "ready", value: { grants: [], denies: [], wildcard: true } } };
+  return { props, posts };
+}
+
+it("可见天数首次设置必须填写上下限，提交后显示保存结果", async () => {
+  const { props, posts } = fixture();
+  render(<StaffShiftAttendancePage {...props} />);
+  fireEvent.click(screen.getByText("设置本经营主体的排班可见天数"));
+  const save = await screen.findByText("保存可见天数");
+  fireEvent.click(save);
+  expect(posts).toHaveLength(0);
+  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("可见天数"), { target: { value: "3" } });
+  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("天数下限"), { target: { value: "1" } });
+  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("天数上限"), { target: { value: "14" } });
+  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("配置事由"), { target: { value: "调整展示" } });
+  fireEvent.click(save);
+  await screen.findByText("本经营主体的排班可见天数已保存。");
+  expect(posts[0]?.body).toMatchObject({ value: 3, min_value: 1, max_value: 14, reason: "调整展示" });
+});

diff --git a/backend/src/main/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffApprovalService.java b/backend/src/main/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffApprovalService.java
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..22bce290
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/src/main/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffApprovalService.java
@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+package com.complex.platform.access.staff;
+
+// 文件版本：V0.05
+
+import com.complex.platform.access.AuthorizationService;
+import com.complex.platform.access.staff.dto.StaffShiftBatchResult;
+import com.complex.platform.common.api.ApiException;
+import com.complex.platform.governance.review.SupervisorReviewDecisionRecord;
+import com.complex.platform.governance.review.SupervisorReviewEvaluateRequest;
+import com.complex.platform.governance.review.SupervisorReviewService;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.UUID;
+import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener;
+import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
+import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
+
+/** 员工业务复用现有审批链；审批记录与实际发布处于同一事务。 */
+@Service
+public class StaffApprovalService {
+    private final JdbcStaffRepository repository;
+    private final SupervisorReviewService reviews;
+    private final AuthorizationService authorization;
+    private final ObjectMapper json;
+
+    public StaffApprovalService(JdbcStaffRepository repository, SupervisorReviewService reviews,
+            AuthorizationService authorization, ObjectMapper json) {
+        this.repository = repository;
+        this.reviews = reviews;
+        this.authorization = authorization;
+        this.json = json;
+    }
+
+    StaffShiftBatchResult submitShifts(List<StaffShiftRecord> drafts, String key) {
+        String actor = authorization.currentActor().id();
+        String proposal = drafts.stream().map(draft -> {
+            var before = repository.findShiftById(draft.id()).orElse(null);
+            String name = repository.findProfileByUserId(draft.userId()).map(StaffProfileRecord::name).orElse(draft.userId());
+            return name + "：" + (before == null ? "新增" : before.startAt() + " 至 " + before.endAt())
+                    + " → " + draft.startAt() + " 至 " + draft.endAt()
+                    + "；点位：" + String.join("、", draft.pointSpaceIds())
+                    + "；缘由：" + (draft.note() == null ? "新排班" : draft.note());
+        }).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.joining("\n"));
+        var review = reviews.evaluate(new SupervisorReviewEvaluateRequest(key + ":review", "排班发布审批",
+                List.of(), "staff.shift.publish", "staff_shift_batch", "batch_" + UUID.randomUUID(),
+                0L, proposal, null, List.of()));
+        int created = 0;
+        for (var draft : drafts) {
+            var before = repository.findShiftById(draft.id()).orElse(null);
+            if (before == null) created++;
+            repository.saveShiftRevision(draft.id(), review.reviewId(), encode(before), encode(draft), actor);
+        }
+        return new StaffShiftBatchResult(created, drafts.size() - created,
+                drafts.stream().map(row -> row.awaitingReview(review.reviewId())).toList(),
+                review.reviewId(), "pending_review");
+    }
+
+    SupervisorReviewDecisionRecord submitPenaltyCap(StaffNumericSetting value,
+            com.complex.platform.access.staff.dto.StaffPenaltyCapRequest request) {
+        var before = repository.numericSetting("payroll_penalty_cap_bps", "global");
+        var review = reviews.evaluate(new SupervisorReviewEvaluateRequest(request.idempotencyKey()+":review", request.reason(),
+                List.of(), "staff.payroll.penalty_cap.adjust", "staff_penalty_cap", "cap_"+UUID.randomUUID(),
+                0L, "普通扣除上限由 " + before.value() + " 调整为 " + value.value() + "（万分比）：" + request.reason(),
+                null, request.parallelLines()));
+        repository.savePenaltyCapRevision(review.reviewId(), before, value, authorization.currentActor().id());
+        return review;
+    }
+
+    @EventListener
+    @Transactional
+    public void afterDecision(SupervisorReviewDecisionRecord decision) {
+        if (!"approved".equals(decision.reviewStatus())) return;
+        if ("staff.payroll.penalty_cap.adjust".equals(decision.actionType())) {
+            repository.applyPenaltyCapRevision(decision.reviewId());
+            return;
+        }
+        if (!"staff.shift.publish".equals(decision.actionType())) return;
+        for (var revision : repository.shiftRevisions(decision.reviewId(), null, true)) {
+            if (revision.appliedAt() == null) {
+                repository.publishShiftRevision(revision, decode(revision.beforeValue()), decode(revision.afterValue()));
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    public record History(String revisionId, String reviewId, StaffShiftRecord before, StaffShiftRecord after,
+            java.time.Instant appliedAt) {}
+
+    List<History> history(String shiftId) {
+        return repository.shiftRevisions(null, shiftId, false).stream()
+                .map(row -> new History(row.id(), row.reviewId(), decode(row.beforeValue()), decode(row.afterValue()), row.appliedAt())).toList();
+    }
+
+    private String encode(StaffShiftRecord record) {
+        if (record == null) return null;
+        try { return json.writeValueAsString(record); }
+        catch (java.io.IOException e) { throw ApiException.conflict("SHIFT_SNAPSHOT_FAILED", "排班记录保存失败"); }
+    }
+
+    private StaffShiftRecord decode(String value) {
+        if (value == null) return null;
+        try { return json.readValue(value, StaffShiftRecord.class); }
+        catch (java.io.IOException e) { throw ApiException.conflict("SHIFT_SNAPSHOT_FAILED", "排班历史记录读取失败"); }
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+package com.complex.platform.access.staff;
+
+// 文件版本：V0.01
+
+import com.complex.platform.common.api.ApiResponse;
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestHeader;
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
+
+/** U05-006：柜机单端上报格口事件——与 kiosk config/heartbeat 同一套 X-Device-Token 设备认证，不带员工会话。 */
+@RestController
+@RequestMapping("/api/v1/terminals/kiosks")
+public class StaffLockerKioskController {
+    private final StaffLockerService lockers;
+
+    public StaffLockerKioskController(StaffLockerService lockers) {
+        this.lockers = lockers;
+    }
+
+    @PostMapping("/{device_id}/locker-events")
+    public ApiResponse<StaffLockerService.Receipt> lockerEvent(@PathVariable("device_id") String deviceId,
+            @RequestHeader(value = "X-Device-Token", required = false) String deviceToken,
+            @RequestBody StaffLockerService.ScanEvent event) {
+        return ApiResponse.ok(lockers.record(deviceId, deviceToken, event));
+    }
+}
diff --git a/backend/src/main/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffLockerService.java b/backend/src/main/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffLockerService.java
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..863ad898
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/src/main/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffLockerService.java
@@ -0,0 +1,159 @@
+package com.complex.platform.access.staff;
+
+// 文件版本：V0.02
+
+import com.complex.platform.access.AuthorizationService;
+import com.complex.platform.common.api.ApiException;
+import com.complex.platform.common.idempotency.IdempotencyService;
+import com.complex.platform.evidence.AuditEventService;
+import com.complex.platform.terminal.TerminalDeviceRepository;
+import com.complex.platform.terminal.TerminalDeviceRecord;
+import java.time.Instant;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.Map;
+import java.util.UUID;
+import org.springframework.jdbc.core.namedparam.MapSqlParameterSource;
+import org.springframework.jdbc.core.namedparam.NamedParameterJdbcTemplate;
+import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
+import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
+
+/** 柜端扫码完成后的留痕入口（U05-006 单端契约：柜机设备令牌 + 员工短时扫码凭证）；开锁及厂商扫码身份对接由实际柜机适配，不生成手工登记表。 */
+@Service
+public class StaffLockerService {
+    private final NamedParameterJdbcTemplate jdbc;
+    private final AuthorizationService authorization;
+    private final JdbcStaffRepository staff;
+    private final TerminalDeviceRepository devices;
+    private final IdempotencyService idempotency;
+    private final AuditEventService audit;
+
+    public StaffLockerService(NamedParameterJdbcTemplate jdbc, AuthorizationService authorization,
+            JdbcStaffRepository staff, TerminalDeviceRepository devices, IdempotencyService idempotency, AuditEventService audit) {
+        this.jdbc=jdbc; this.authorization=authorization; this.staff=staff; this.devices=devices; this.idempotency=idempotency; this.audit=audit;
+    }
+
+    /** 柜机单端上报：scanToken 为员工手机出示的短时扫码凭证（U05-006），不再要求同一请求带员工会话。 */
+    public record ScanEvent(String idempotencyKey, String slotRef, String action, String scanToken) {}
+    public record Receipt(String id, String staffProfileId, String cabinetDeviceId, String slotRef,
+            Instant storedAt, Instant retrievedAt) {}
+    public record ScanTokenRequest(String idempotencyKey) {}
+    public record ScanToken(String token, Instant expiresAt) {}
+
+    static final long SCAN_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 120;
+
+    /** 员工本人会话申请扫码凭证（手机端展示为二维码，由柜机扫入）。一次性、120 秒内有效。 */
+    @Transactional
+    public ScanToken issueScanToken(ScanTokenRequest request) {
+        try {
+        authorization.requirePermission("staff.profile.self");
+        var profile=staff.findProfileByUserId(authorization.currentActor().id())
+                .filter(p -> "approved".equals(p.registrationStatus()) && !"approved".equals(p.deleteStatus()))
+                .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.forbidden("STAFF_NOT_FOUND", "当前身份没有有效员工档案"));
+        return idempotency.execute("staffLockerScanToken:"+profile.id(), request==null?null:request.idempotencyKey(), request, () -> {
+            byte[] raw=new byte[32]; new java.security.SecureRandom().nextBytes(raw);
+            String token=java.util.Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(raw);
+            Instant expires=Instant.now().plusSeconds(SCAN_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS);
+            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO staff_locker_scan_tokens(id,token_hash,staff_profile_id,expires_at) VALUES(:id,:hash,:staff,:exp)",
+                    new MapSqlParameterSource().addValue("id","lst_"+UUID.randomUUID()).addValue("hash",sha256Hex(token))
+                            .addValue("staff",profile.id()).addValue("exp",java.sql.Timestamp.from(expires)));
+            audit.recordSuccess("staff.locker.scan_token_issued","staff.profile.self","staff_profile",profile.id(),null,request==null?null:request.idempotencyKey(),
+                    Map.of("expires_at",expires.toString()));
+            return new ScanToken(token, expires);
+        }, ScanToken.class);
+        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
+            audit.recordFailure("staff.locker.scan_token_failed", "staff.profile.self", "staff_profile", null, null, request == null ? null : request.idempotencyKey(), exception instanceof ApiException api ? api.code() : exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
+            throw exception;
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** 柜机（已登记 kiosk，X-Device-Token 认证）上报格口事件；员工身份仅由扫码凭证承载并在服务端换回。 */
+    @Transactional
+    public Receipt record(String kioskDeviceId, String deviceToken, ScanEvent event) {
+        try {
+        if (event==null || event.slotRef()==null || event.slotRef().isBlank() || event.slotRef().length()>128
+                || !("store".equals(event.action()) || "retrieve".equals(event.action()))
+                || event.scanToken()==null || event.scanToken().isBlank()) {
+            throw ApiException.badRequest("VALIDATION_FAILED", "柜机事件须包含格口编号、存入或取出动作及员工扫码凭证");
+        }
+        var device=requireBoundKiosk(kioskDeviceId, deviceToken);
+        return idempotency.execute("staffLockerScan:"+device.deviceId(), event.idempotencyKey(), event,
+                () -> save(event, consumeScanToken(event.scanToken(), device.deviceId()), device.deviceId()), Receipt.class);
+        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
+            audit.recordFailure("staff.locker.record_failed", null, "staff_locker_record", kioskDeviceId, null, event == null ? null : event.idempotencyKey(), exception instanceof ApiException api ? api.code() : exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
+            throw exception;
+        }
+    }
+
+    private TerminalDeviceRecord requireBoundKiosk(String kioskDeviceId, String deviceToken) {
+        String token=deviceToken==null?null:deviceToken.trim();
+        if (kioskDeviceId==null || kioskDeviceId.isBlank() || token==null || token.isEmpty()) {
+            throw ApiException.unauthorized("DEVICE_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED", "缺少柜机设备令牌（X-Device-Token）");
+        }
+        var device=devices.findByDeviceId(kioskDeviceId.trim()).filter(d -> "bound".equals(d.status()) && "kiosk".equals(d.terminalType()))
+                .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.forbidden("LOCKER_DEVICE_REQUIRED", "柜机未登记或已停用"));
+        var credential=devices.findDeviceCredentialByDeviceId(device.deviceId())
+                .filter(c -> "active".equals(c.status()) && java.security.MessageDigest.isEqual(
+                        c.tokenSha256().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
+                        sha256Hex(token).getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)))
+                .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.forbidden("DEVICE_CREDENTIAL_INVALID", "柜机设备令牌无效"));
+        return device;
+    }
+
+    private String consumeScanToken(String token, String cabinet) {
+        Instant now=Instant.now();
+        var rows=jdbc.query("SELECT id,staff_profile_id,expires_at,used_at FROM staff_locker_scan_tokens WHERE token_hash=:hash FOR UPDATE",
+                Map.of("hash",sha256Hex(token.trim())),
+                (rs,n)->new Object[]{rs.getString("id"),rs.getString("staff_profile_id"),rs.getTimestamp("expires_at").toInstant(),rs.getTimestamp("used_at")});
+        if (rows.isEmpty() || rows.getFirst()[3]!=null || ((Instant)rows.getFirst()[2]).isBefore(now)) {
+            throw ApiException.forbidden("LOCKER_SCAN_TOKEN_INVALID", "员工扫码凭证无效、已使用或已过期，请重新出示");
+        }
+        String profileId=(String)rows.getFirst()[1];
+        var profile=staff.findProfileById(profileId)
+                .filter(p -> "approved".equals(p.registrationStatus()) && !"approved".equals(p.deleteStatus()))
+                .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.forbidden("STAFF_NOT_FOUND", "扫码凭证对应的员工档案已失效"));
+        jdbc.update("UPDATE staff_locker_scan_tokens SET used_at=:now, used_by_device_id=:dev WHERE id=:id",
+                new MapSqlParameterSource().addValue("now",java.sql.Timestamp.from(now)).addValue("dev",cabinet).addValue("id",rows.getFirst()[0]));
+        return profile.id();
+    }
+
+    static String sha256Hex(String value) {
+        try {
+            byte[] digest=java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(value.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
+            StringBuilder sb=new StringBuilder(digest.length*2);
+            for (byte b : digest) sb.append(String.format("%02x", b));
+            return sb.toString();
+        } catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
+            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    private Receipt save(ScanEvent event, String profile, String cabinet) {
+        var params=new MapSqlParameterSource().addValue("cabinet",cabinet).addValue("slot",event.slotRef().trim());
+        // 同一格口的存取串行，先完成存入的员工占用；取出后可由其他员工使用。
+        jdbc.query("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(:lock,0))",
+                Map.of("lock",cabinet+":"+event.slotRef().trim()), rs -> {});
+        List<Receipt> open=jdbc.query("SELECT * FROM staff_locker_records WHERE cabinet_device_id=:cabinet AND slot_ref=:slot AND retrieved_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE",
+                params,(rs,n)->new Receipt(rs.getString("id"),rs.getString("staff_profile_id"),rs.getString("cabinet_device_id"),rs.getString("slot_ref"),
+                        rs.getTimestamp("stored_at").toInstant(),null));
+        Instant now=Instant.now();
+        Receipt receipt;
+        if ("store".equals(event.action())) {
+            if (!open.isEmpty()) throw ApiException.conflict("LOCKER_SLOT_OCCUPIED", "该格口尚未取空，请选择空闲格口");
+            receipt=new Receipt("locker_"+UUID.randomUUID(),profile,cabinet,event.slotRef().trim(),now,null);
+            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO staff_locker_records(id,staff_profile_id,cabinet_device_id,slot_ref,stored_at) VALUES(:id,:staff,:cabinet,:slot,:now)",
+                    params.addValue("id",receipt.id()).addValue("staff",profile).addValue("now",java.sql.Timestamp.from(now)));
+        } else {
+            if (open.isEmpty() || !profile.equals(open.getFirst().staffProfileId())) {
+                throw ApiException.forbidden("LOCKER_OWNER_REQUIRED", "该格口没有当前员工的待取记录");
+            }
+            var stored=open.getFirst();
+            receipt=new Receipt(stored.id(),profile,cabinet,stored.slotRef(),stored.storedAt(),now);
+            jdbc.update("UPDATE staff_locker_records SET retrieved_at=:now WHERE id=:id",
+                    params.addValue("id",stored.id()).addValue("now",java.sql.Timestamp.from(now)));
+        }
+        // U14-005：单一成功事件名，动作进明细。
+        audit.recordSuccess("staff.locker.recorded",null,"staff_locker_record",receipt.id(),null,event.idempotencyKey(),
+                Map.of("action",event.action(),"cabinet_device_id",cabinet,"slot_ref",receipt.slotRef(),"staff_profile_id",profile,"source","cabinet_scan"));
+        return receipt;
+    }
+}

diff --git a/backend/src/main/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffRegistrationService.java b/backend/src/main/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffRegistrationService.java
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..c754f259
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/src/main/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffRegistrationService.java
@@ -0,0 +1,161 @@
+package com.complex.platform.access.staff;
+
+// 文件版本：V0.03
+
+import com.complex.platform.access.AccessActor;
+import com.complex.platform.access.AccessRepository;
+import com.complex.platform.access.staff.dto.StaffSelfRegistrationRequest;
+import com.complex.platform.common.api.ApiException;
+import com.complex.platform.common.idempotency.IdempotencyRepository;
+import com.complex.platform.common.idempotency.IdempotencyService;
+import com.complex.platform.evidence.AuditEventService;
+import com.complex.platform.governance.BusinessEntityRecord;
+import com.complex.platform.governance.MerchantRecord;
+import com.complex.platform.governance.PlatformRepository;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
+import java.time.Instant;
+import java.util.*;
+import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
+import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
+import static com.complex.platform.common.Strings.trimToNull;
+
+
+/** 注册阶段尚无员工账号；公开入口只产生待审申请，不发放账号或权限。 */
+@Service
+public class StaffRegistrationService {
+    private final JdbcStaffRepository staff;
+    private final PlatformRepository platform;
+    private final AccessRepository access;
+    private final AuditEventService audit;
+    private final IdempotencyService publicRequests;
+    private static final Set<String> COMPANY_ROLES = Set.of("platform", "project_company", "management_company");
+
+    public StaffRegistrationService(JdbcStaffRepository staff, PlatformRepository platform, AccessRepository access,
+            AuditEventService audit, IdempotencyRepository idempotency, ObjectMapper json) {
+        this.staff = staff;
+        this.platform = platform;
+        this.access = access;
+        this.audit = audit;
+        // 公开申请没有已认证主体，复用幂等实现的独立操作命名空间；响应仅含申请编号与状态。
+        this.publicRequests = new IdempotencyService(idempotency, json);
+    }
+
+    public record CompanyOption(String id, String name) {}
+    public record Receipt(String id, String registrationStatus) {}
+
+    public List<CompanyOption> companies() {
+        List<CompanyOption> options = platform.listBusinessEntities().stream().filter(e -> "active".equals(e.status()) && COMPANY_ROLES.contains(e.entityRole()))
+                .map(e -> new CompanyOption(e.id(),e.entityName())).toList();
+        audit.recordSuccess("staff.registration_companies_viewed", null, "business_entity", "all", null, null, Map.of("count", options.size()));
+        return options;
+    }
+
+    @Transactional
+    public Receipt selfRegister(StaffSelfRegistrationRequest request) {
+        try {
+        if (request == null) throw ApiException.badRequest("VALIDATION_FAILED", "须填写注册资料");
+        String name = requireText(request.name(), "员工姓名");
+        if (name.length()>128 || (request.phone()!=null && request.phone().length()>64)
+                || (request.idDoc()!=null && request.idDoc().length()>128)) {
+            throw ApiException.badRequest("VALIDATION_FAILED", "注册资料长度超出限制");
+        }
+        // U05-003/U06-002：公开入口的唯一身份证明是该私人手机安装时生成的设备公钥/指纹（不读硬件识别码）；缺失或不符即拒。
+        String devicePublicKey = requireText(request.devicePublicKey(), "私人手机设备公钥");
+        String deviceFingerprint = requireText(request.deviceFingerprintHash(), "私人手机设备指纹");
+        byte[] der;
+        try {
+            der = java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(devicePublicKey);
+        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
+            throw ApiException.badRequest("DEVICE_PROOF_INVALID", "设备公钥须为 Base64 编码的 X.509 公钥");
+        }
+        if (der.length == 0 || !deviceFingerprint.equalsIgnoreCase(sha256Hex(der))) {
+            throw ApiException.badRequest("DEVICE_PROOF_INVALID", "设备指纹与设备公钥不符");
+        }
+        String companyId = requireText(request.companyId(), "所属公司");
+        if (companies().stream().noneMatch(c -> c.id().equals(companyId))) {
+            throw ApiException.badRequest("COMPANY_NOT_FOUND", "所属公司不存在或已停用");
+        }
+        String merchantId = trimToNull(request.merchantId());
+        if (merchantId != null) {
+            MerchantRecord merchant = requireMerchant(merchantId);
+            if (!"self_operated".equals(merchant.cooperationForm()) || companyChain(merchant).stream().noneMatch(c -> c.id().equals(companyId))) {
+                throw ApiException.badRequest("COMPANY_SELF_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED", "该商户不属于所选公司的自营商户");
+            }
+        }
+        return publicRequests.execute("publicStaffSelfRegistration", request.idempotencyKey(), request, () -> {
+            // 同一指纹只能绑定一名员工；放在幂等执行内，同一请求重放仍返回原申请编号。
+            if (staff.isFingerprintBound(deviceFingerprint)) {
+                throw ApiException.conflict("DEVICE_ALREADY_BOUND", "该私人手机已绑定其他员工，不能重复注册");
+            }
+            Instant now = Instant.now();
+            var profile = new StaffProfileRecord("staff_"+UUID.randomUUID(),projectOf(companyId),merchantId,null,name,
+                    trimToNull(request.phone()),trimToNull(request.idDoc()),null,"submitted",null,null,null,"active",now,now)
+                    .withCompanyRoute(companyId,"company_self");
+            staff.saveProfile(profile);
+            // 安装即绑定：首次私人手机绑定直接生效（T1 当前实现），审批通过后即可按该凭证验签。
+            staff.saveCredential(new StaffDeviceCredentialRecord("scred_"+UUID.randomUUID(), profile.id(), devicePublicKey,
+                    deviceFingerprint.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT), "active", null, "trusted", null, now, null, now, now));
+            audit.recordSuccess("staff.self_registered",null,"staff_profile",profile.id(),null,request.idempotencyKey(),
+                    Map.of("company_id",companyId,"registration_source","company_self","device_fingerprint_hash",deviceFingerprint));
+            return new Receipt(profile.id(),profile.registrationStatus());
+        },Receipt.class);
+        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
+            audit.recordFailure("staff.self_register_failed", null, "staff_profile", null, null, request == null ? null : request.idempotencyKey(), exception instanceof ApiException api ? api.code() : exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
+            throw exception;
+        }
+    }
+
+    String actorCompany(AccessActor actor) {
+        String ownCompany = staff.findProfileByUserId(actor.id()).map(StaffProfileRecord::companyId).orElse(null);
+        if (ownCompany != null) return ownCompany;
+        return access.findUserPositionAssignment(actor.id()).map(p -> trimToNull(p.organizationId()))
+                .orElseGet(() -> requireText(actor.organizationId(), "所属公司"));
+    }
+
+    String merchantApprovingCompany(String merchantId) {
+        MerchantRecord merchant = requireMerchant(requireText(merchantId,"商户"));
+        if ("self_operated".equals(merchant.cooperationForm())) throw ApiException.badRequest("COMPANY_SELF_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED", "自营商户员工须在私人手机自助注册");
+        // main 无主体父链（V410 已删 parent_entity_id，PGM-018/019 三角色多对多）：审批域公司＝商户当前生效的经营主体公司。
+        return companyChain(merchant).getFirst().id();
+    }
+
+    private String projectOf(String companyId) {
+        // 员工档案 project_id 与既有 requireProjectScope（actor.organizationId）同义＝所属公司本身；main 无父链可上溯。
+        return platform.listBusinessEntities().stream()
+                .filter(e -> e.id().equals(companyId) && "active".equals(e.status()) && COMPANY_ROLES.contains(e.entityRole()))
+                .map(BusinessEntityRecord::id).findFirst()
+                .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.conflict("REGISTRATION_PROJECT_UNRESOLVED", "所属公司不存在、已停用或不是经营主体公司"));
+    }
+
+    private static String sha256Hex(byte[] bytes) {
+        try {
+            byte[] digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes);
+            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(digest.length * 2);
+            for (byte b : digest) sb.append(String.format("%02x", b));
+            return sb.toString();
+        } catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
+            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static String requireText(String value, String label) {
+        String result=trimToNull(value);
+        if (result==null) throw ApiException.badRequest("VALIDATION_FAILED", "请填写"+label);
+        return result;
+    }
+
+    private MerchantRecord requireMerchant(String id) {
+        return platform.findMerchantById(id).filter(m -> "active".equals(m.status()) && m.archivedAt()==null && !"approved".equals(m.deleteStatus()))
+                .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.badRequest("MERCHANT_NOT_FOUND", "商户不存在、已停用或已存档"));
+    }
+
+    private List<BusinessEntityRecord> companyChain(MerchantRecord merchant) {
+        // 商户的经营主体公司＝生效绑定的运营主体，否则档案上的 business_entity_id；单层，不再沿已删除的父链向上收集。
+        String id = platform.findActiveBusinessEntityBindingByMerchantId(merchant.id())
+                .map(b -> b.operationEntityId()).orElse(merchant.businessEntityId());
+        List<BusinessEntityRecord> companies = platform.listBusinessEntities().stream()
+                .filter(e -> e.id().equals(id) && "active".equals(e.status()) && COMPANY_ROLES.contains(e.entityRole())).toList();
+        if (companies.isEmpty()) throw ApiException.conflict("REGISTRATION_COMPANY_UNRESOLVED", "该商户尚未维护有效的经营主体公司归属");
+        return companies;
+    }
+}

         // K16 一步到位：登记设备时可直接给定所属商户（核销上下文），免运营二次改绑；可空。

 ) {

+-- 文件版本：V0.02
+-- M010-017/M010-029：复用一张表存放两项明确要求可配置的员工业务参数。
+CREATE TABLE staff_policy_settings (
+    policy_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (policy_key IN ('shift_visible_days', 'payroll_penalty_cap_bps')),
+    scope_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
+    numeric_value INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    min_value INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    max_value INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    updated_by VARCHAR(128),
+    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+    PRIMARY KEY (policy_key, scope_id),
+    CHECK (min_value <= numeric_value AND numeric_value <= max_value),
+    CHECK ((policy_key = 'shift_visible_days' AND min_value >= 1)
+        OR (policy_key = 'payroll_penalty_cap_bps' AND scope_id = 'global' AND min_value >= 0 AND max_value <= 10000))
+);
+INSERT INTO staff_policy_settings(policy_key, scope_id, numeric_value, min_value, max_value)
+VALUES ('payroll_penalty_cap_bps', 'global', 2000, 0, 10000);
+-- U05-005/U10-003（BSM L1444「出厂默认 7 天，须同时配置上下限」；BSM-001 未填上下限的参数不得上线）：
+-- 可见天数全局出厂行；上下限 1..31 为操作员 2026-09-10 裁定的上线配置；各经营主体的 merchant:/company: 行缺失时回落到本行。
+INSERT INTO staff_policy_settings(policy_key, scope_id, numeric_value, min_value, max_value)
+VALUES ('shift_visible_days', 'global', 7, 1, 31);

+-- 文件版本：V0.01
+-- U05-006（PGM L582 / BSM L938「由柜子自动记录，不设手工登记」）：员工在本人手机会话下申请的短时扫码凭证；
+-- 柜机以已登记 kiosk 设备令牌单端上报格口事件时，服务端凭该凭证换回员工身份。一次性、到期作废。
+CREATE TABLE staff_locker_scan_tokens (
+    id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
+    token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+    staff_profile_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES staff_profiles(id),
+    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
+    used_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
+    used_by_device_id VARCHAR(64),
+    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE INDEX idx_staff_locker_scan_tokens_profile ON staff_locker_scan_tokens(staff_profile_id);

+CREATE TABLE staff_shift_covers (
+    id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
+    shift_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES staff_shift_schedules(id),
+    original_user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

+    reason TEXT NOT NULL,

+    CONSTRAINT chk_staff_shift_cover_distinct CHECK (cover_user_id <> original_user_id)
+);
+CREATE INDEX idx_staff_shift_covers_shift ON staff_shift_covers(shift_id);

diff --git a/backend/src/test/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/M010RegistrationHttpTests.java b/backend/src/test/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/M010RegistrationHttpTests.java
new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/src/test/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/M010RegistrationHttpTests.java
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+package com.complex.platform.access.staff;
+
+// 文件版本：V0.03
+import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
+import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.*;
+import java.util.UUID;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
+import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
+import org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
+import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
+import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
+import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
+
+@SpringBootTest(properties = { "spring.datasource.url=jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:5432/complex_test",
+        "spring.datasource.username=complex", "spring.datasource.password=${COMPLEX_DATABASE_PASSWORD:complex_dev_pwd}" })
+@AutoConfigureMockMvc
+@Transactional
+class M010RegistrationHttpTests {
+    @Autowired MockMvc mvc;
+
+    @Test void unregisteredEmployeeCanSubmitButReceivesOnlyPendingReceipt() throws Exception {
+        // U01-001/U05-003/U11-007：私人手机通道以 staff_private_phone 声明，并携带安装时生成的设备公钥/指纹；无证明 → 400。
+        String noProof = "{\"idempotency_key\":\""+UUID.randomUUID()+"\",\"company_id\":\"be_proj_changsha\",\"name\":\"自助申请\",\"phone\":\"13800138000\"}";
+        mvc.perform(post("/api/v1/staff/self-registrations").header("X-Terminal-Type", "staff_private_phone").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).content(noProof))
+                .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());
+        String[] proof = StaffTestActors.deviceProof();
+        String body = "{\"idempotency_key\":\""+UUID.randomUUID()+"\",\"company_id\":\"be_proj_changsha\",\"name\":\"自助申请\",\"phone\":\"13800138000\","
+                + "\"device_public_key\":\""+proof[0]+"\",\"device_fingerprint_hash\":\""+proof[1]+"\"}";
+        mvc.perform(post("/api/v1/staff/self-registrations").header("X-Terminal-Type", "staff_private_phone").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).content(body))
+                .andExpect(status().isOk()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.registration_status").value("submitted"))
+                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.id").isString()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.phone").doesNotExist())
+                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.user_id").doesNotExist());
+        mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/staff/registration-companies"))
+                .andExpect(status().isOk()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.data[0].name").isString());
+    }
+
+    @Test void openingSelfRegistrationDoesNotOpenManagementOrApproval() throws Exception {
+        mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/staff/profiles")).andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
+        mvc.perform(post("/api/v1/staff/registrations/unknown/review").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
+                .content("{\"idempotency_key\":\"test\",\"decision\":\"approve\"}"))
+                .andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
+    }
+}

+    @Test void lockerScanRecordsIdentityTimesAndAllowsAnotherEmployeeAfterRetrieval() {
+        // U05-006/U11-006（PGM L582/BSM L938）：柜机凭设备令牌单端上报；员工身份只由本人手机会话申请的短时扫码凭证承载。
+        var a = profile(null);
+        var b = profile(null);
+        String device = "cabinet_"+key();
+        String kioskToken = "kiosk-"+key();
+        Instant now=Instant.now();
+        terminals.save(new com.complex.platform.terminal.TerminalDeviceRecord(device,device,device,"kiosk","space",null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,"bound",now,null,null,null,null,now,now));
+        terminals.saveDeviceCredential(new com.complex.platform.terminal.DeviceCredentialRecord(device, StaffLockerService.sha256Hex(kioskToken), "active", now, now));
+        // 无凭证 / 错令牌 / 员工会话直接上报 → 拒
+        assertThatThrownBy(() -> lockers.record(device, "wrong-token", new StaffLockerService.ScanEvent(key(),"1","store","x")))
+                .isInstanceOfSatisfying(ApiException.class, e -> assertThat(e.code()).isEqualTo("DEVICE_CREDENTIAL_INVALID"));
+        assertThatThrownBy(() -> lockers.record(device, kioskToken, new StaffLockerService.ScanEvent(key(),"1","store","not-a-token")))
+                .isInstanceOfSatisfying(ApiException.class, e -> assertThat(e.code()).isEqualTo("LOCKER_SCAN_TOKEN_INVALID"));
+        owner(a);
+        var tokenA=lockers.issueScanToken(new StaffLockerService.ScanTokenRequest(key()));
+        SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
+        var event=new StaffLockerService.ScanEvent(key(),"1","store",tokenA.token());
+        var stored=lockers.record(device, kioskToken, event);
+        assertThat(lockers.record(device, kioskToken, event).id()).isEqualTo(stored.id());
+        assertThat(stored.staffProfileId()).isEqualTo(a.id());
+        assertThat(stored.cabinetDeviceId()).isEqualTo(device);
+        assertThat(stored.storedAt()).isNotNull();
+        assertThat(repository.countProfileReferences(a.id())).isEqualTo(1);
+        // 已用凭证不能再次使用
+        assertThatThrownBy(() -> lockers.record(device, kioskToken, new StaffLockerService.ScanEvent(key(),"2","store",tokenA.token())))
+                .isInstanceOfSatisfying(ApiException.class, e -> assertThat(e.code()).isEqualTo("LOCKER_SCAN_TOKEN_INVALID"));
+        owner(b);
+        var tokenB1=lockers.issueScanToken(new StaffLockerService.ScanTokenRequest(key()));
+        var tokenB2=lockers.issueScanToken(new StaffLockerService.ScanTokenRequest(key()));
+        SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
+        assertThatThrownBy(() -> lockers.record(device, kioskToken, new StaffLockerService.ScanEvent(key(),"1","store",tokenB1.token())))
+                .isInstanceOfSatisfying(ApiException.class, e -> assertThat(e.code()).isEqualTo("LOCKER_SLOT_OCCUPIED"));
+        assertThatThrownBy(() -> lockers.record(device, kioskToken, new StaffLockerService.ScanEvent(key(),"1","retrieve",tokenB2.token())))
+                .isInstanceOfSatisfying(ApiException.class, e -> assertThat(e.code()).isEqualTo("LOCKER_OWNER_REQUIRED"));
+        owner(a);
+        var tokenA2=lockers.issueScanToken(new StaffLockerService.ScanTokenRequest(key()));
+        SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
+        var taken=lockers.record(device, kioskToken, new StaffLockerService.ScanEvent(key(),"1","retrieve",tokenA2.token()));
+        assertThat(taken.id()).isEqualTo(stored.id());
+        assertThat(taken.retrievedAt()).isAfterOrEqualTo(stored.storedAt());
+        assertThat(repository.countProfileReferences(a.id())).isZero();
+        owner(b);
+        var tokenB3=lockers.issueScanToken(new StaffLockerService.ScanTokenRequest(key()));
+        SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
+        var reused=lockers.record(device, kioskToken, new StaffLockerService.ScanEvent(key(),"1","store",tokenB3.token()));
+        assertThat(reused.id()).isNotEqualTo(stored.id());
+        assertThat(reused.staffProfileId()).isEqualTo(b.id());
+        assertThat(jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT count(*) FROM staff_locker_records WHERE cabinet_device_id=?",Long.class,device)).isEqualTo(2L);
+    }

+    @Test void selfRegistrationRequiresPrivatePhoneDeviceProof() {
+        // U05-003/U11-007（PGM L579/BSM L935）：无设备公钥/指纹、指纹不符、同指纹重复注册均拒；有证明则凭证随申请绑定为 active。
+        SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
+        assertThatThrownBy(() -> registrations.selfRegister(new StaffSelfRegistrationRequest(key(),"m010_p",null,"无证明","13800138000",null,null,null)))
+                .isInstanceOfSatisfying(ApiException.class, e -> assertThat(e.code()).isEqualTo("VALIDATION_FAILED"));
+        var proof = StaffTestActors.deviceProof();
+        assertThatThrownBy(() -> registrations.selfRegister(new StaffSelfRegistrationRequest(key(),"m010_p",null,"指纹不符","13800138000",null,proof[0],"00ff")))
+                .isInstanceOfSatisfying(ApiException.class, e -> assertThat(e.code()).isEqualTo("DEVICE_PROOF_INVALID"));
+        var receipt = registrations.selfRegister(new StaffSelfRegistrationRequest(key(),"m010_p",null,"有证明","13800138000",null,proof[0],proof[1]));
+        var credential = repository.findActiveCredential(receipt.id()).orElseThrow();
+        assertThat(credential.deviceFingerprintHash()).isEqualTo(proof[1]);
+        assertThat(credential.devicePublicKey()).isEqualTo(proof[0]);
+        assertThatThrownBy(() -> registrations.selfRegister(new StaffSelfRegistrationRequest(key(),"m010_p",null,"同一手机再注册","13800138000",null,proof[0],proof[1])))
+                .isInstanceOfSatisfying(ApiException.class, e -> assertThat(e.code()).isEqualTo("DEVICE_ALREADY_BOUND"));
+    }

+        service.closePayroll(new StaffPayrollCloseRequest(key(), "2099-08"));
+        // U05-004/U11-004：封顶分母＝HTML 总薪资（基础+补贴+绩效+奖金）；现行列只有固定与奖金 → 20%×(10000+1000)=2200，提成不入分母。
+        assertThat(jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT penalty_cent FROM staff_payroll_statements WHERE user_id=? AND month='2099-08'",
+                Long.class, profile.userId())).isEqualTo(2200L);
+        // U05-002/U11-003：事假按应发（10000+9000+1000=20000）的 1/2 班次扣 10000 → 总额 20000−2200−10000=7800。
+        assertThat(jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT leave_deduction_cent FROM staff_payroll_statements WHERE user_id=? AND month='2099-08'",
+                Long.class, profile.userId())).isEqualTo(10000L);
+        assertThat(jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT total_cent FROM staff_payroll_statements WHERE user_id=? AND month='2099-08'",
+                Long.class, profile.userId())).isEqualTo(7800L);
+    }
+}

diff --git a/backend/src/test/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffTestActors.java b/backend/src/test/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffTestActors.java
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..71825678
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/src/test/java/com/complex/platform/access/staff/StaffTestActors.java
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+package com.complex.platform.access.staff;
+
+// 文件版本：V0.02
+
+import com.complex.platform.access.*;
+import com.complex.platform.auth.SessionIssuer;
+import java.time.Instant;
+import java.util.List;
+import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
+import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
+import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
+
+/** 测试明确写入角色授权，不依赖管理员类型自动拥有敏感权限。事务结束自动回滚。 */
+final class StaffTestActors {
+    static void grant(JdbcTemplate jdbc, AccessRepository access, String id, String project) {
+        if (access.findUserById(id).isEmpty()) access.createUser(new AccessUser(id,id,"staff",project,null,"active",Instant.now()));
+        jdbc.update("INSERT INTO roles(id,role_name,description,data_scope,status,created_at) VALUES('role_m010_fixture','M010 测试管理','M010 测试角色','platform','active',now()) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING");
+        jdbc.update("INSERT INTO role_permissions(role_id,permission_code) SELECT 'role_m010_fixture',permission_code FROM permissions WHERE permission_code LIKE 'staff.%' OR permission_code='governance.supervisor_review.approve' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING");
+        access.assignUserRole(id,"role_m010_fixture");
+    }
+    static void actor(String id, String type, String project, String merchant) {
+        SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
+                new AccessActor(id,id,type,project,merchant,"active"),"test",List.of()));
+    }
+    static void master() {
+        SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
+                new AccessActor(SessionIssuer.MASTER_USER_ID,SessionIssuer.MASTER_USERNAME,"platform_admin",null,null,"active"),"test",List.of()));
+    }
+
+    /** U05-003/U11-007：模拟私人手机安装时生成的 EC 密钥对 → [Base64(X.509 DER 公钥), SHA-256(DER) 十六进制指纹]。 */
+    static String[] deviceProof() {
+        try {
+            var generator = java.security.KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("EC");
+            generator.initialize(256);
+            byte[] der = generator.generateKeyPair().getPublic().getEncoded();
+            byte[] digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(der);
+            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
+            for (byte b : digest) sb.append(String.format("%02x", b));
+            return new String[] { java.util.Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(der), sb.toString() };
+        } catch (java.security.GeneralSecurityException e) {
+            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
+        }
+    }
+}

+    /** 处罚上限调整固定三条平行线（hr/finance/legal），发起时缺任一线最终审批人即拒（fail-closed）。 */
+    @Test
+    void penaltyCapAdjustRequiresFinalApproverOnEachDepartmentLine() {
+        chainL1();
+        TestSecurityActors.asSupervisorLevel(1);
+        var missingHr = new SupervisorReviewEvaluateRequest("u12-cap-missing", "n", List.of(), "staff.payroll.penalty_cap.adjust",

+    }
+
+    /** 三审未齐时顶层（master）先批被拒 DEPARTMENT_REVIEWS_PENDING；三线齐后 master 确认，整单终态经注入的发布器发出。 */
+    @Test
+    void penaltyCapAdjustNeedsDepartmentReviewsBeforeMasterAndPublishesTerminalDecision() {
+        chainL1();
+        for (String code : List.of("hr_review", "finance_review", "legal_review")) {
+            // 与 V418 种子一致：hr_review 线无起点人，线上唯一节点＝发起时指定的最终审批人。
+            reviewRepository.lines.put(code, new SupervisorReviewRepository.ApprovalLine(code, code, 1, null, "active"));
+        }
+        TestSecurityActors.asSupervisorLevel(1);
+        var lines = List.of(new SupervisorReviewEvaluateRequest.ParallelLine("hr_review", "usr_hr_review_final"),
+                new SupervisorReviewEvaluateRequest.ParallelLine("finance_review", "usr_finance_review_final"),
+                new SupervisorReviewEvaluateRequest.ParallelLine("legal_review", "usr_legal_review_final"));
+        var pending = service.evaluate(new SupervisorReviewEvaluateRequest("u12-cap", "n", List.of(), "staff.payroll.penalty_cap.adjust",
+                "staff_policy", "cap_u12_2", 0L, null, null, lines));
+        assertThat(pending.reviewStatus()).isEqualTo("pending_review");
+        var nodes = reviewRepository.listChainNodes(pending.reviewId());
+        assertThat(nodes).extracting(ApprovalChainNode::lineCode).contains("hr_review", "finance_review", "legal_review", ApprovalChainNode.MAIN_LINE);
+        var master = nodes.stream().filter(n -> ApprovalChainNode.KIND_MASTER.equals(n.approverKind())).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        assertThat(master.lineCode()).isEqualTo(ApprovalChainNode.MAIN_LINE);
+        // 主线上的直接上级节点先逐级通过，master 成为当前节点后仍须等三条部门线（DEPARTMENT_REVIEWS_PENDING）。
+        for (var node : nodes.stream().filter(n -> ApprovalChainNode.MAIN_LINE.equals(n.lineCode()) && !ApprovalChainNode.KIND_MASTER.equals(n.approverKind())).toList()) {
+            TestSecurityActors.asSupervisor(node.approverId(), 10);
+            service.approve(pending.reviewId(), new SupervisorReviewApprovalRequest("u12-cap-main-" + node.seq(), "n", List.of("att"), null, "approved", "主线逐级"));
+        }
+        publishedEvents.clear();
+        asMasterAuthority();
+        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.approve(pending.reviewId(), new SupervisorReviewApprovalRequest("u12-cap-master-early", "n", List.of("att"), null, "approved", "确认")))
+                .isInstanceOfSatisfying(ApiException.class, e -> assertThat(e.code()).isEqualTo("DEPARTMENT_REVIEWS_PENDING"));
+        assertThat(publishedEvents).isEmpty();
+        for (var line : lines) {
+            TestSecurityActors.asSupervisor(line.finalApproverId(), 3);
+            service.approve(pending.reviewId(), new SupervisorReviewApprovalRequest("u12-cap-" + line.lineCode(), "n", List.of("att"), null, "approved", "部门审核"));
+        }
+        asMasterAuthority();
+        var done = service.approve(pending.reviewId(), new SupervisorReviewApprovalRequest("u12-cap-master", "n", List.of("att"), null, "approved", "确认"));
+        assertThat(done.reviewStatus()).isEqualTo("approved");
+        assertThat(publishedEvents).extracting(e -> ((SupervisorReviewDecisionRecord) e).reviewId()).contains(pending.reviewId());
+    }
+
+    /** 排班发布走 one_level_up：直接上级是唯一审批节点，发起人不能自批，上级批准即 approved 并发布终态事件。 */
+    @Test
+    void shiftPublishFollowsOneLevelUpChainAndPublishesApproval() {
+        chainL1();
+        TestSecurityActors.asSupervisorLevel(1);
+        var pending = service.evaluate(evaluate("u12-shift", "排班", List.of(), "staff.shift.publish", "staff_shift", "shift_u12", 0L, null));
+        assertThat(pending.reviewStatus()).isEqualTo("pending_review");
+        var nodes = reviewRepository.listChainNodes(pending.reviewId());
+        assertThat(nodes).hasSize(1);
+        assertThat(nodes.getFirst().approverId()).isEqualTo("usr_reviewer_a");
+        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.approve(pending.reviewId(), new SupervisorReviewApprovalRequest("u12-shift-self", "n", List.of(), null, "approved", "自批")))
+                .isInstanceOfSatisfying(ApiException.class, e -> assertThat(e.code()).isEqualTo("SUPERVISOR_SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN"));
+        publishedEvents.clear();
+        TestSecurityActors.asSupervisor("usr_reviewer_a", 3);
+        var approved = service.approve(pending.reviewId(), new SupervisorReviewApprovalRequest("u12-shift-sup", "n", List.of(), null, "approved", "上一级批准"));
+        assertThat(approved.reviewStatus()).isEqualTo("approved");
+        assertThat(publishedEvents).extracting(e -> ((SupervisorReviewDecisionRecord) e).reviewId()).containsExactly(pending.reviewId());
+    }

+                        "test", List.of()));

 x-contract-rules:
   permissionExtension: "`x-permission` 仅表达员工/系统权限码或 public/authenticated/not_applicable 三类通用状态"
   authContextExtension: "`x-auth-context` 表达 customer-token/device-credential/open-app-credential/webhook-signature 等鉴权上下文"
   requestBodyRule: 所有 P0 写接口必须使用字段级 requestBody schema，不得使用 GenericWrite 作为正式编码输入
   idempotencyRule: x-idempotency-required=true 的接口必须校验 X-Idempotency-Key，并保证重试返回一致结果+全链路留痕
-  terminalAllowedRule: x-terminal-allowed 只能使用 unified-standards-baseline D5 的 10 个终端码；设备能力写入 x-device-capability，服务端/监控调用写入 x-invocation-channel。
-  authContextRule: 每个 operation 必须显式声明 x-auth-context，允许值为 public、staff-token、customer-token、device-credential、open-app-credential、webhook-signature；不得用 x-permission 或 x-data-scope 代替认证上下文。
+  terminalAllowedRule: x-terminal-allowed 只能使用 unified-standards-baseline D5 的 10 个终端码；设备能力写入

+  authContextRule: 每个 operation 必须显式声明 x-auth-context，允许值为
+    public、staff-token、customer-token、device-credential、open-app-credential、webhook-signature；不得用 x-permission 或
+    x-data-scope 代替认证上下文。

+# T1 员工三表 可编码开发规格 V0.13（2026-06-18）
 
 > **任务**：R5 backlog **T1（员工档案/设备凭证/通知三表）**，W0 底座，**解锁 T9（Android 设备凭证）**。
 > **裁决依据**：R5 裁决⑨——员工三表 + Android 端凭证本期 P0；MDM 自有侧字段暂缓。
 > **关键边界**：本规格的 `staff_device_credentials`（员工私人手机 Keystore 公钥/不可逆指纹）与既有 `terminal_device_credentials`（V011，kiosk 一体机随机 token）是**两套完全不同实体**，互不复用、互不串值。
-> **工程约定**（对齐既有迁移）：`id VARCHAR(64)` 主键；`TIMESTAMPTZ ... DEFAULT now()`；CHECK 命名 `chk_<表>_<字段>`、唯一 `uq_<表>_<列>`；隔离列 `project_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL`、`merchant_id VARCHAR(64)`（NULL=平台员工）；个人信息只存不可逆哈希（PIPL，compliance §4）。
-> **迁移**：当前最新 V065，本任务取 **V066**（连续取号）；测试用 `MigrationVersions.latest()` 动态读版本（R3 已去硬钉，无需改 12 处 JDBC 测试）。落地后把 `matrix-migration-claims.json` 中 `staff_profiles`/`staff_device_credentials`/`employee_notices` 由 absent 改 present。
+> **工程约定**（对齐既有迁移）：`id VARCHAR(64)` 主键；`TIMESTAMPTZ ... DEFAULT now()`；CHECK 命名 `chk_<表>_<字段>`、唯一 `uq_<表>_<列>`；隔离列 `project_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL`、`merchant_id VARCHAR(64)`（NULL=平台员工）；姓名、手机号与证件使用既有 PiiCipher 加密存放；phone/id_doc 接收原值，日常 HTTP 响应强制脱敏，不从旧哈希恢复。
+> **迁移**：三表最初由 V066 建立；本次员工域迁移以 main 已应用的 V410 之后连续编号为 V411—V421（原稿 V400—V409 低于 V410，按 U10-001 重编号；V421 为寄存柜扫码凭证表）；测试用 `MigrationVersions.latest()` 动态读版本（R3 已去硬钉，无需改 12 处 JDBC 测试）。落地后把 `matrix-migration-claims.json` 中 `staff_profiles`/`staff_device_credentials`/`employee_notices` 由 absent 改 present。
+
+## M010 当前实现（2026-09-08）
+
+- 注册分两条路径：商户通过 `/staff/registrations` 代提交，审批域公司＝该商户当前生效的经营主体公司（main 主体拓扑为三角色多对多，无固定父链）；公司员工在私人手机 App 安装时由 Keystore 生成设备密钥，以私人手机通道（终端类型 `staff_private_phone`）调用公开 `/staff/self-registrations` 本人提交，请求必须携带该手机的设备公钥与指纹并随申请绑定本人（缺失、不符或指纹已绑他人即拒），公开入口按认证类频控；公司列表来自 `/staff/registration-companies`。合作方式为「自营」的商户视同公司自有，其员工使用公司员工路径。公开提交只返回申请编号与待审状态，审核前不产生账号。提交人不得自审；公司审批与商户提交分开。
+- 姓名、手机号和证件由现有 PiiCipher 加密；日常接口固定脱敏手机和证件。任职状态独立保存待入职、在职、试岗、停岗、离职，与审批、存档分开。通知和私人手机操作仅限本人；首次私人手机绑定直接生效，换机及异常后的复核保留。删除须先存档、最高权限批准且无现存引用；未结束排班和未取寄存物也属于引用。
+- 单次或整周排班先完整验证，再通过现有主管上一级审批。批准前不写入已发布排班；修改由原发起人在班次开始前填写原因，前后快照和审批编号追加留存。审批单包含人员、前后时间、点位和原因。可见天数按经营主体设置，出厂含今天共七天，配置须同时填写上下限。
+- 普通扣除合计按当月总薪资的比例封顶，默认20%；总薪资按 HTML 为基础工资、各项补贴、绩效工资与奖金之和（现行列只有固定工资与奖金两项先取全，补贴/绩效列落地后并入分母），提成不进入分母，事假单算。上限变更要求人事、财务、法务均通过，再由最高权限最终确认；已月结月份保留原上限快照。事假按已批准且覆盖实际排班的请假工时占当期总工时的比例，从当期应发薪资（固定工资+提成+奖金，个税与处罚另算）中扣减，下限为零。跨月班次按结束时点归属，月历只采用属于该班次的打卡。
+- 柜机以已登记 kiosk 设备令牌（`X-Device-Token`）单端调用 `/api/v1/terminals/kiosks/{device_id}/locker-events` 上报扫码完成事件；员工身份只由本人手机会话申请的一次性短时扫码凭证（`POST /api/v1/staff/lockers/scan-token`，120 秒内有效）承载并由服务端换回，不要求同一请求带员工会话；`staff_locker_records` 留存格口和存取时刻。重复事件按幂等键返回原结果，未取空格口不能给他人使用，取空后可流动使用。员工不用另外填写登记表。此处完成的是软件事件记录；厂商扫码身份接入、物理开锁协议尚缺资料，未声称完成设备联调。
+

 ## 1. 端侧能力（私人手机 App，仅注册/通知/状态，不进现场业务）
-1. **注册**：提交员工资料 → `POST /api/v1/staff/registrations`；展示审批结果（轮询/通知 → `GET /api/v1/staff/notices`）。
+1. **注册**：公司员工在私人手机 App（终端类型 `staff_private_phone`，安装时由 Keystore 生成设备密钥）本人填写资料并选择公司，调用 `POST /api/v1/staff/self-registrations`，请求携带该手机的设备公钥与指纹并随申请绑定本人；工作手机应用不提供自助注册入口。商户代员工提交调用 `/staff/registrations`。合作方式为「自营」的商户视同公司自有员工。已登录后本人通知使用 `GET /api/v1/staff/notices`。
 2. **设备凭证生成与绑定**：
    - 用 Android **Keystore** 生成设备密钥对（优先 StrongBox/TEE，`setIsStrongBoxBacked`，回退 TEE）；私钥不可导出。
    - 生成**不可逆设备指纹哈希**（设备稳定标识 + Keystore 公钥摘要的单向哈希，**不读手机本机 NFC 唯一标识**，D8）。
-   - `POST /api/v1/staff/device-credentials` 提交 `device_public_key` + `device_fingerprint_hash` → 后端置 `pending_review`。
+   - `POST /api/v1/staff/device-credentials` 提交 `device_public_key` + `device_fingerprint_hash` → 后端校验本人归属，首次直接 `active`；换机或异常后重新绑定为 `pending_review`。
 3. **完整性检测**：启动/关键操作前检测 Root/调试/异常环境（Play Integrity API 或等效 + 本地 root 检测）；异常 → `POST /staff/device-credentials/{id}/report-integrity(status=root_detected|debug_detected|abnormal)` → 后端自动 revoke + 通知。
 4. **换机**：旧机解绑（或新机绑定触发 supersedes 链）→ 新机 `POST /staff/device-credentials`（pending_review，supersedes=旧 active）→ 后台审批后新 active、旧 superseded。App 引导"先解绑旧再绑新"。
 5. **通知/同意**：拉取 `employee_notices`，合规同意项 `POST /staff/notices/{id}/acknowledge`。

 ## 2. 实现（复用既有模块）
 - `TerminalApiClient`：新增 staff 注册/凭证/通知端点调用方法。
 - `TerminalModels`：新增 StaffRegistration/DeviceCredential/Notice DTO（与后端 OpenAPI 对齐）。
-- 新增 `DeviceCredentialManager`（Keystore 生成/签名、指纹哈希、Root 检测封装）。
+- 复用 `DeviceKeystore` 生成公钥、指纹和请求签名；不新增重复的密钥管理抽象。
 - `MainActivity` 扩为注册/绑定/状态界面（替换纯健康检查）。
 - 请求鉴权：凭证绑定后，端侧用 Keystore 私钥对请求挑战签名，后端用 `device_public_key` 验签（与后端 `report-integrity`/敏感操作配套；本期最小实现可先做绑定+状态）。
 
+### M010 工作手机领取与签验
+
+公司工作手机沿用 `terminal_devices.staff_id` 对应员工，重新登记保持该对应关系。设备管理员在本机登记设备编号、公钥；编号保存在本机配置，员工后续登录直接使用，不要求每次重复绑定。公司工作手机公钥存入 `terminal_device_signing_keys`，与私人手机凭证分开。
+
+两个现有客户端共用 `DeviceRequestHeaders`：设备编号、毫秒时间戳、随机请求号、方法、路径和正文摘要由本机私钥签名。后台同时核对设备状态和员工归属。只声明终端类型不足以打卡。
+
+打卡页使用实际扫码或 NFC 回调，不提供手工录入打卡。应用运行且员工已登录时，系统充电断开事件会提交领取记录；三种领取方式按服务器最早已接收记录去重。后台拒绝私人手机、未验证设备和其他员工的工作手机。实机 NFC、Keystore、充电设施触发及应用进程退出后的硬件上报尚未验证，不能以 JVM 测试或安装包构建代替实机验收。柜机扫码和开锁的厂商接口接入同样须等待真实资料。
+
+主管手机排班提交后显示待审和审批编号，批准前不显示为已发布。
+
 ## 3. MDM（预留 + 开关，本期暂缓自有侧）
 - 不落 MDM 自有侧字段（二轮裁决）；仅保留 MDM 纳管结果消费接口占位 + 后台开关（`integration.mdm.*`，T2 门控）。受管工作手机的白名单/网站拦截由外部商业 MDM + Android Enterprise/AMAPI 负责。
 
 ## 4. 验收（GWT）
-- Given 新安装 App，When 注册并绑定，Then 生成 Keystore 密钥对 + 指纹哈希，后端凭证 pending_review，审批后 active。
+- Given 新安装 App，When 注册并绑定，Then 生成 Keystore 密钥对 + 指纹哈希，本人首次绑定后端凭证直接 active；不另设人工审批。
 - Given Root 设备，When 启动检测，Then 上报 root_detected，后端凭证 revoked + 发通知，App 进失效复核态。
 - Given 换机，When 新机绑定，Then 走 pending_review + supersedes，审批后旧 superseded、新 active（唯一 active 成立）。
 - Given 私人手机，When 尝试现场业务操作，Then App 不提供入口（仅注册/通知/状态）。
